result:
Comments, deleting, reporting and auto-hiding are in. `bun run typecheck` passes and `guren check` reports no failures (5 warnings, which I didn't read). I didn't run the app or write any tests, so the endpoints and the post page have never been exercised.

- **Storage:**
  - `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports`. Reports have a unique index on `(comment_id, user_id)`, and both tables cascade from their parent.
  - The migration is `db/migrations/20261023005022_comments`; I generated it but didn't run `bun run db:migrate`.
- **Endpoints:**
  - The new `CommentController` handles `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id` and `POST /comments/:id/report`. All three sit behind the existing `auth` middleware, so a guest is redirected to `/login`.
  - A comment body is trimmed and must be 1 to 2000 characters, otherwise validation fails as it does for a post title.
  - Delete is allowed for the comment's author or the post's author through a new `CommentPolicy`; anyone else gets 403.
  - Report always returns 204 and stores one row per user per comment.
- **Post page:** `GET /posts/:id` now also passes `comments`, oldest first, as `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`. A comment with three or more different reporters is left out, but its row stays in the database. `posts/Show.tsx` shows the list, a comment box when signed in, Report, and Delete for the two allowed people.
- **Post deletion:** `PostController.destroy` explicitly removes the post's comments and their reports before deleting the post. I did this in code as well as in the schema because I wasn't sure SQLite enforces cascades here.

The new files are the two models, `CommentResource`, `CommentValidator` and `CommentPolicy`. I also edited `routes/web.ts` and `AuthorizationProvider` to register the routes and the policy.
